# djust

> djust is a Python/Rust framework that brings Phoenix LiveView-style reactive server-side rendering to Django. Real-time UI updates over WebSockets with ~80 KB gzipped client JS, zero build step, and Rust-powered VDOM diffing + template rendering (roughly 7-11x faster than Django on variable- and filter-heavy templates; see the README's Performance section for the measured table and the benchmark script).

## Application conventions for AI agents

Read [Application engineering conventions](https://github.com/djust-org/djust/blob/main/docs/ai/conventions.md)
and the [focused AI reference](https://github.com/djust-org/djust/tree/main/docs/ai).
Use documentation matching the installed release; main may describe newer APIs.

## UI building blocks — use these before writing markup

djust ships template-tag components (`djust.components`) and a theming system (`djust.theming`). Use them instead of hand-written tables, long reactive `<select>`s, overlays, flash messages and color stylesheets: `python manage.py djust_audit --ast` flags those (X101–X106).

| You need | Use |
| --- | --- |
| Page layout: header, sidebar, content | `{% app_shell %}`, `{% sidebar %}`, `{% page_header %}`, `{% breadcrumb %}` |
| Table of records: sort, select, paginate, scroll | `{% data_table %}`, `{% data_grid %}`, `{% pagination %}`, `{% infinite_scroll %}` |
| Filters and search above a list | `{% filter_bar %}`, `{% search_input %}` |
| Choosing from many options | `{% combobox %}`, `{% rich_select %}`, `{% multi_select %}` |
| Form fields and errors | `{% dj_form %}`, `{% dj_input %}`, `{% dj_select %}`, `{% date_picker %}`, `{% form_errors %}` |
| Side panel, dialog, confirmation | `{% sheet %}`, `{% modal %}`, `{% confirm_dialog %}` |
| Flash messages and notifications | `{% toast_container %}`, `{% server_toast_container %}`, `{% page_alert %}`, `{% alert %}` |
| Empty and loading states | `{% empty_state %}`, `{% skeleton %}`, `{% spinner %}` |
| Dashboards and metrics | `{% stat_card %}`, `{% dashboard_grid %}`, `{% bar_chart %}`, `{% line_chart %}` |
| Tabs, steps and wizards | `{% tabs %}`, `{% stepper %}`, `{% wizard %}` |
| Menus and actions | `{% dropdown_menu %}`, `{% toolbar %}`, `{% command_palette %}` |
| Status labels | `{% badge %}`, `{% status_indicator %}` |

### Setup

- `pip install "djust[components]"`, then add `"djust.components"` and `"djust.theming"` to `INSTALLED_APPS`; `djust new` does both.
- Load the tags with `{% load djust_components %}`; `python manage.py djust_ai suggest "<what you need>"` prints a snippet with the required props.
- Configure `LIVEVIEW_CONFIG["theme"]` with `"theme"`, `"preset"` and `"default_mode"`.
- In the base template: `{% load theme_tags %}` and `{% theme_head %}` (it also links the components' stylesheet).
- List the built-in presets with `python manage.py djust_theme list-presets`.

### Discovery commands

```text
  python manage.py check                         # Django + djust system checks (agents also get a discovery hint)
  python manage.py djust_check                   # djust's checks only, with pretty output
  python manage.py djust_ai inventory --json     # what's installed/enabled here, component catalog, theme
  python manage.py djust_ai suggest "<intent>"   # intent -> components + tag + snippet
  python manage.py djust_ai manifest             # one llms.txt-style doc (directives, components, theming, best practices)
  python manage.py djust_audit --ast             # security + UI rules
  python manage.py djust_mcp                     # MCP server (list_ui_components / get_ui_component for the component catalog)
```

## Docs

- [Getting Started](https://djust.org/docs/getting-started/): Installation, setup, and your first LiveView
- [Core Concepts](https://djust.org/docs/core-concepts/): LiveView lifecycle, mount/render cycle, event handling
- [Components](https://djust.org/docs/components/): LiveComponent, stateful and stateless components
- [State Management](https://djust.org/docs/state/): Decorators (@debounce, @throttle, @cache and DraftModeMixin are wired; @optimistic and @client_state are inert markers — #2699, #2680)
- [Forms](https://djust.org/docs/forms/): FormMixin, real-time validation, form handling patterns
- [Testing](https://djust.org/docs/testing/): LiveViewTestClient, SnapshotTestMixin, LiveViewSmokeTest
- [API Reference](https://djust.org/docs/api/): Full API documentation
- [Features](https://djust.org/features/): Feature overview and capabilities
- [Security](https://djust.org/security/): Security model, CSRF, authorization patterns
- [Examples](https://djust.org/examples/): Interactive code examples
- [Benchmarks](https://djust.org/benchmarks/): Performance comparisons
- [FAQ](https://djust.org/faq/): Common questions and answers
